CCD-STeDe links climate-change science with sustainable territorial development across a consortium spanning Italy, Ecuador, Portugal, Burkina Faso and South Africa. The first call for the 2026/2027 academic year closed on 15 February 2026, and the next round is expected on a similar February timeline.

Programme Highlights

  • Genuinely global consortium with mobility inside and outside Europe
  • February first-call deadline pattern for scholarship consideration
  • Multilingual tracks (English plus Spanish/French/Portuguese pathways)
  • Careers in climate adaptation, territorial planning and development cooperation

Who Should Apply

Graduates in environmental science, geography, development studies, agriculture and related fields; fieldwork readiness matters in this programme.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students: participation costs plus monthly allowance.

Deadline and How to Apply

Watch the CCD-STeDe site for the new call and submit through the application form during the first-call window. Key deadline information: 15 February 2027 (expected — the 2026/2027 first call closed 15 February 2026).
